title: DATS Test File
description: Schema for Declarative Automated Testing System (.dats) files

$schema.description: Optional reference to this JSON Schema

tests.description: Array of test cases (at least one; the runner rejects an empty array)

desc.description: Optional description of the test case

cmd.description: Command to execute (via bash -c). {inputs.X} expands to the absolute path of the declared input file X; {outputs.X} expands to an absolute path in the test's private outputs directory (no outputs.files check required). The same expansion is applied to inputs.files contents.

exit.description: Expected exit code (0-255) or exit code name (default 0)

oneOf.$comment: Only the names the runner resolves (EXIT_SUCCESS=0, EXIT_FAILURE=1); any other EXIT_* name is rejected at parse time because it could never pass a run.

timeout.description: Optional per-test timeout: an integer number of seconds, or a Go duration string (e.g. "500ms", "2s", "1m30s"). 0 or omitted means no timeout.

stdin.description: Content piped to the command's stdin

files.description: Fixture files to create before running, mapping filename to content. Contents go through the same {inputs.X}/{outputs.X} placeholder expansion as cmd.

stdout.description: Stdout checks. Array form: literal substrings that must each appear anywhere in stdout. Map form: 0-indexed line number to regex that must match (unanchored search) within that line; addressing a nonexistent line fails.

stderr.description: Stderr checks. Array form: literal substrings that must each appear anywhere in stderr. Map form: 0-indexed line number to regex that must match (unanchored search) within that line; addressing a nonexistent line fails.

!stdout.description: Negated stdout checks. Array form: literal substrings that must NOT appear anywhere in stdout. Map form: 0-indexed line number to regex that must NOT match (unanchored search) within that line; a nonexistent line passes.

!stderr.description: Negated stderr checks. Array form: literal substrings that must NOT appear anywhere in stderr. Map form: 0-indexed line number to regex that must NOT match (unanchored search) within that line; a nonexistent line passes.

files.description: Output file validations, mapping filename to checks

!files.description: Negated output file validations, mapping filename to checks. Each check is inverted: exists is flipped (exists: true means the file must NOT exist), match patterns must NOT match the contents (a missing file passes), and notMatch patterns MUST match the contents (a missing file fails).

json_output.description: Expected JSON value of the whole stdout. Stdout must parse as a single JSON value that deep-equals this value: object keys are order-insensitive, array elements are order-sensitive, numbers compare by value (2 == 2.0). Any JSON value is allowed here, including null (which asserts stdout is exactly the JSON null).

outputCheck.description: Output validation - either an array of literal substrings or a map of line-specific regex checks

oneOf.description: Literal substrings matched anywhere in the whole output. NOT regexes - metacharacters have no special meaning.

Map of 0-indexed line numbers to Go/RE2 regexes. Each regex is searched UNANCHORED within its line - use ^...$ to pin the whole line. Positive checks fail when the addressed line does not exist; negated checks pass.

match.description: Go/RE2 regex patterns that must match the file's contents (under !files: must NOT match; a missing file passes there)

notMatch.description: Go/RE2 regex patterns that must NOT match the file's contents (a missing file passes; under !files: MUST match, and a missing file fails)
